description: A dry desert village at sunset. A young woman with long braids and a yellow headscarf, in dusty overalls, kneels in the sand and catches clean water in her hands as it pours from a tap on a tall new machine covered in solar panels into a clay pot. She laughs, presses her wet hands to her face, then throws her head back and raises her hands in joy while the water keeps running into the pot. Behind her a workbench with tools and notes stands by rusty metal cabinets, and a crowd of children cheer and hold up cups, bowls and pots.

de.answer: Sie fängt sauberes Wasser mit ihren Händen auf.
de.question: Was fängt die Frau auf?
